originalEntry.title: Open-ended show-off motion graphic
originalEntry.title_zh: 放手让它自由发挥的动效片
originalEntry.author: nolkeeg
originalEntry.description: A 45-second motion graphic where Opus 5.5 picks the style and subject itself, told not to use memories or skills and to beat GPT 6.
originalEntry.description_zh: 不给方向、不许调用记忆和技能，让 Opus 5.5 自选风格和主题，做出 45 秒动效片。
originalEntry.prompt: Please do not reference any previous memories or skills. I've been seeing all of these motion graphics examples on X of people making cool videos with opus 5.5. So - I want you to just show off for me. You pick the design style, the look, subject etc. I just want to be extremely impressed by the motion graphic video that you create. I want you to destroy GPT 6 when it comes to motion graphics video - because astra just wants to give me a stupid glorified powerpoint presentation.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 请不要参考任何之前的记忆或技能。我在 X 上看到很多人用 opus 5.5 做出很酷的动态图形视频。所以——我希望你尽情给我炫一下技。设计风格、视觉、主题等都由你来选。我只想被你做的动态图形视频狠狠惊艳到。我希望你在动态图形视频上碾压 GPT 6——因为 astra 只会给我一个愚蠢的、美化过的 powerpoint 演示。
